name: EcoRoute Fleet Web & Mobile API Contract

roles.manager: Full fleet read/write, truck management, GA route planning, integrity verification, backup/restore, settings
roles.driver: Scoped to submitting telemetry, fuel logs, and route events for assigned truckId only

deduplication.behavior: Duplicate eventId returns status='duplicate' without double-counting CO2 or distance

validationBounds.lat: [-90, 90] finite number (0 is valid; lat and lon must be supplied together)

rules: odometerKm must be >= truck's previous recorded odometerKm
dateTime must be valid ISO-8601 and not in the future

routeEventContract.rules: Zero (0) is preserved as a valid metric; savings and CO2 values are computed server-side from verified fuel inputs and server UTC date.

hashChainContract.canonicalFormat: prevHash + "\n" + JSON.stringify([truckId, tripId, seq, ts, speedKmh, rpm, fuelRateLph, engineLoadPct, coolantC, cargoKg, idle, fuelMl, co2G])

carbonCreditsAndEmissions.creditDefinition: 1 Carbon Credit = 1,000 kg (1 metric tonne) CO2e

Diesel.source: UK DEFRA / DESNZ Greenhouse Gas Conversion Factors

CNG.source: UK DEFRA / DESNZ Conversion Factors (measured by mass in kg)
